purpose: Specify negative test cases for wallet submit console (external signer validation, double-spend prevention, signature verification, key type checks)

testCases.name: Submit Unsigned Draft (No Witness Data)
testCases.description: Attempt to submit draft transaction without witness/signature data
testCases.precondition: Draft transaction exists but witness field is empty
testCases.action: Call submit endpoint with draft.witness = null or empty string
testCases.expectedBehavior: rejected by submit console (unsigned transaction disallowed)
testCases.why: All submissions must be signed; prevents broadcasting of unsigned transactions

testCases.name: Submit Using Local Key (Non-External Signer)
testCases.description: Attempt to submit draft signed with local private key instead of external signer (KasWare)
testCases.action: Call submit endpoint with local-key signer
testCases.expectedBehavior: rejected by submit console (local keys disallowed)
testCases.why: TN12 settlement requires external signer (KasWare/hardware) for key security; prevents local key exposure

testCases.name: Double-Spend Same UTXO in Two Submissions
testCases.description: Submit two different transactions spending the same input UTXO
testCases.precondition: UTXO tx:0 prepared in two different drafts
testCases.action: Submit both drafts (first succeeds, second attempts to spend same UTXO)
testCases.expectedBehavior: second submission rejected (input already spent by first)
testCases.why: Submit console tracks submitted UTXOs; prevents double-spend within submit session

testCases.name: Submit with Invalid Signature Format
testCases.description: Draft includes witness that is not valid hex or is truncated
testCases.action: Call submit endpoint with malformed witness
testCases.expectedBehavior: rejected by submit console (signature format validation fails)
testCases.why: Signatures must be valid hex; prevents broadcast of malformed transactions

testCases.name: Signature from Wrong Key (Key-Signature Mismatch)
testCases.description: Attempt to submit draft signed with key that doesn't match contract requirements
testCases.precondition: Contract expects signature from BUY_KEY; draft signed with SELL_KEY
testCases.expectedBehavior: rejected by covenant validation on-chain (or by submit console pre-check if implemented)
testCases.why: Signature must match the key expected by covenant; prevents unauthorized signers

testCases.name: Submit Transaction with Non-Existent UTXO
testCases.description: Draft references UTXO that doesn't exist on-chain
testCases.action: Call submit endpoint; transaction broadcast attempts to spend missing UTXO
testCases.expectedBehavior: rejected by mempool (orphan UTXO) or by consensus later
testCases.why: Cannot spend non-existent UTXO; prevents invalid transactions

testCases.name: Transaction Burns Funds (Output + Fee != Input)
testCases.description: Transaction output and fee sum to less than input amount (funds destroyed)
testCases.precondition: Input = 100 TKAS; Output = 40 TKAS; Fee = 50 TKAS → Lost: 10 TKAS
testCases.expectedBehavior: rejected by submit console (amount conservation check)
testCases.why: All funds must be accounted for (output + fee = input); prevents accidental loss

testCases.name: Excessive Fee (Overpay Significantly)
testCases.description: Draft includes suspiciously high fee (e.g., 90% of input amount)
testCases.precondition: Input = 100 TKAS; Fee = 90 TKAS; Output = 10 TKAS
testCases.expectedBehavior: warning/confirmation required (not rejected, but flagged as unusual)
testCases.why: Excessive fees are likely user error; submit console should warn operator

testCases.name: Transaction with Zero-Value Output
testCases.description: After fee, output amount is exactly zero
testCases.expectedBehavior: rejected by submit console or validator (zero-value outputs disallowed)
testCases.why: Cannot create zero-value outputs; prevents fund destruction

testCases.name: Submit with Reordered Inputs/Outputs
testCases.description: Draft reorders inputs or outputs from canonical order, breaking commitment
testCases.precondition: Signed draft has committed to specific input/output order
testCases.expectedBehavior: rejected by covenant (signature no longer matches reordered transaction)
testCases.why: Reordering changes transaction hash; invalidates signature

testCases.name: Submit Same Draft Concurrently (Race Condition)
testCases.description: Two users/operators submit identical draft at the same time
testCases.precondition: Draft TX_HASH already submitted and broadcast
testCases.expectedBehavior: second submission rejected (same draft already submitted)
testCases.why: Prevents duplicate submission; dedups by txid/draft hash

testCases.name: Submit After Signer Session Expires
testCases.description: Draft signed by KasWare; session times out before submission
testCases.precondition: Signature obtained at T=0; submitted at T=2hours (KasWare session expires 1 hour)
testCases.expectedBehavior: submission succeeds on-chain (signatures don't have session expiry), but may be warned by submit console
testCases.why: Signatures are valid indefinitely; session expiry is UX only

testCases.name: Submitter Identity Doesn't Match Draft Key
testCases.description: User A signs draft; User B attempts to submit (permission issue, not cryptographic)
testCases.precondition: Draft signed by USER_A_KEY; USER_B attempts to submit
testCases.action: Submit console checks submitSubjectPublicKey against signer key
testCases.expectedBehavior: accepted (submit console doesn't enforce key ownership), but audit log flags the mismatch
testCases.why: Cryptographic validation passes (signature is valid); permissions are application-level

executionStrategy.successCriteria: All 13 cases correctly rejected/validated; legitimate submission paths still work

implementationNotes: Wallet negative tests focus on external signer validation, double-spend prevention, and fund conservation. Critical issues are unsigned drafts, local key submission, and signature mismatches. Amount conservation checks (overpayment, zero-output, fund burn) are secondary but important for user protection.
